newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 15.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on January 15:
WASHINGTON - Blue Cross-Blue Shield plans said they will merge to better compete in the region's highly competitive health care market.
WASHINGTON - General Motors Corp is expected to decide this week whether to sell its Hughes Aircraft division to Raytheon Co or Northrop Grumman Corp.
WASHINGTON - Consumer price inflation rose to 3.3 percent for all of last year, the highest rate in six years.
WASHINGTON - Fannie Mae, the nation's largest underwriter of home mortgages, said it earned $712.1 million in the fourth quarter, up 74 percent from $408.3 million in the same quarter of 1995.
